title: Which Benefit or Risk?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Distinguish eight statements from AI-first school stories as one of two benefits or one of six risks.

learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish eight statements drawn from AI-first school stories as one of two benefits or one of six risks, correctly placing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Benefits of AI-first schools, risks of AI-first schools, and the risk-and-response framework, from the section "A Framework for Reading Cases" in Chapter 22.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classify one item at a time with immediate feedback; first-attempt scoring
keyQuestions: What does the statement say about the effect on students?
commonMisconceptions: A story shows only a benefit or only a risk.
Any complaint about AI is a privacy risk.
A high price is only a cost issue, not an equity issue.
assessmentOpportunities: "Tuition of $40,000 to $65,000 a year limits who can attend." Which bin?
Is every complaint about AI a privacy risk?
Can one story show both a benefit and a risk?

controls.name: Category buttons
controls.description: Choose the benefit or risk for the current statement.

controls.name: Submit
controls.description: Checks the choice. Two tries per statement; only the first counts.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: Moves to the next statement. Finish shows the score.

controls.name: Start over
controls.description: Reshuffles and begins a new run.
